versions.changelog:
- Initial release of easy-english-tool: a zero-dependency, embedded MCP server for English learning.
- Provides 22 tools, including vocabulary, articles, quizzes, copy practice, TTS, and pronunciation evaluation.
- Runs entirely in-process with Express; no separate MCP instance or external dependencies required.
- Supports both SSE and streamable HTTP transports; REST API fallback is available for agents without MCP config.
- Production deployment live at https://english.geeyo.com.
